en-AU.title: Impulse - Entertainment Deals
en-AU.subtitle: Last-minute plans in Sydney
en-AU.promoText: Last-minute deals at Sydney venues, with the price already worked out. Book in a tap, bring your friends, show your code at the door.
en-AU.description:
Impulse finds you something good to do tonight.

Sydney venues drop last-minute deals on their quiet hours: bars, restaurants, bowling, karaoke, mini golf, escape rooms, arcades and more. You see the real price up front, book in a tap, and show your door code when you arrive.

FIND IT
- Browse the drops that are live right now near your suburb.
- Every deal shows the discounted price, the time and what's included.

CLAIM IT
- Book in seconds with Apple Pay or a saved card.
- We hold your share on your card and only charge it when the venue checks you in.
- Your door code appears in Plans straight away.

BRING YOUR PEOPLE
- Add friends to a booking and split the price, each on their own card.
- Pick people you've booked with before, find friends from your contacts (only when you ask, and your contacts never leave your phone), or send a link to anyone.

SHOW UP
- Show your code at the door. That's it.

Impulse is for people aged 18 and over. Some venues serve alcohol; please drink responsibly.

Available in Sydney, Australia. Questions? support@impulseapp.au
en-AU.releaseNotes: Impulse is here. Last-minute deals at Sydney venues, booked in a tap.

review.notes:
Impulse lets people in Sydney, Australia book last-minute deals that real venues post for their quiet hours, alone or split with friends.

SIGN-IN
Use the demo account in the Sign-In Information fields (email + password on the sign-in screen). It is fully set up: onboarding finished and mobile number already verified, and it has one confirmed booking so you can see Plans and a door code.
Every account needs a verified mobile number, because friends find and invite each other by the numbers saved in their contacts. Creating a new account therefore requires a real mobile number that can receive an SMS code. Guests can browse deals without signing in.

PAYMENTS
Bookings are for real-world experiences at venues, so they are paid with Stripe (Apple Pay or card), not In-App Purchase (guideline 3.1.3(e)). Payments are live. You can review the full flow up to the Apple Pay / card sheet without paying. If you do book, only a hold is placed; cancelling releases it except for the 10% deposit.

PERMISSIONS (all optional, each asked only when used)
- Location: once during setup, to suggest a home suburb. Never in the background.
- Notifications: booking updates.
- Contacts: only when you tap "Find friends in contacts" in the invite sheet. Numbers and emails are hashed on the device; only hashes are sent and none are stored.

ACCOUNT DELETION
You tab > Delete account. It deletes the account immediately and revokes Sign in with Apple.

AGE
Impulse is 18+ (some venues serve alcohol). Onboarding asks users to confirm they are 18 or over and signs out anyone who says no.

Contact: support@impulseapp.au
